name: resumatch-ai
description: ResuMatch AI is a full-stack AI-powered resume platform built with Python and Streamlit. It analyzes resumes for ATS compatibility, matches them against job descriptions to identify skill gaps, and helps users build professional resumes with AI-generated content — all deployed on Streamlit Cloud.

paragraphs: Rule-based ATS scoring, skill-gap analysis against a job description, and a resume builder with three templates.
ResuMatch AI scores a resume the way an ATS would, shows what a job description asks for that the resume does not say, and builds a new one from scratch.

The scoring is rules, not a model, so every point it takes off comes with a reason you can read. AI is used only for the writing suggestions on top of that. The score itself never depends on a model being available.
features: Upload a resume PDF and extract text automatically
Score across 10 weighted dimensions: sections, skills, experience quality, formatting, contact info, education, summary, certifications, keywords, and length
AI-generated improvement suggestions and recommended job roles
Upload resume and paste any job description
